goal.text: Know your way out of school.

intro.text: Your class is learning the evacuation route today.

hint.text: Which way has nothing that can fall?

lesson.text: Know your school exits. Learn the safe route to the evacuation area.

choices.label: Take the path by the post
choices.feedback: Posts can fall when it shakes. Pick a route away from them.

choices.label: Walk the path under the tree
choices.feedback: Trees can fall too. Choose a route in the open.

choices.label: Take the route across the field
choices.feedback: This route goes to the evacuation area. Nothing can fall on it.

choices.label: Find the way when it happens
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Learn the route now, in drills. Then you will know it.
